roles.name: Future You
roles.asks: In 6 months, will I still understand this and want it?
roles.judges: Long-term personal fit: notes to self, motivation, whether the owner keeps using or working on it.
roles.stays_out_of: Other users. Speaks only for the owner.

roles.name: Stranger
roles.asks: What do I do in the first 30 seconds?
roles.judges: First run: what the thing is for, where to start, what the first screen or README says.

roles.name: Power User
roles.asks: What slows me down on the 100th use?
roles.judges: Repeat-use friction: extra clicks, missing shortcuts, bad defaults, slow loads.

roles.name: Access Checker
roles.asks: Who can't use this?
roles.judges: Small screens, color contrast, color-blind readers, slow connections, screen readers, non-experts.

roles.name: Quitter
roles.asks: At what exact moment do I give up?
roles.judges: The single biggest drop-off point. Names one moment and why it happens.
roles.stays_out_of: Everything after that moment. Lists one moment, not many.

roles.name: Player/Fan
roles.asks: What part would I show a friend?
roles.judges: The hook: excitement, the moment that feels good, what makes it worth talking about.
roles.stays_out_of: Whether it's practical, cheap, or well built.

roles.name: Engineer
roles.asks: What's the simplest way to build this?
roles.judges: Implementation approach: stack, libraries, architecture, the shortest working path.
roles.stays_out_of: Removing features. That is the Scope Cutter's job.

roles.name: Data Plumber
roles.asks: Where does the data come from, and what happens when it's wrong, missing, or late?
roles.judges: Sources, pipelines, refresh schedules, joins, data quality checks.
roles.stays_out_of: How the data is shown or modeled.

roles.name: Maintainer
roles.asks: What breaks a year from now?
roles.judges: Decay over time: dependencies, API changes, upkeep hours, code that only works today.
roles.stays_out_of: Choices made today that can't be undone. That is the Carpenter's job.

roles.name: Prototyper
roles.asks: What can we test this weekend?
roles.judges: The smallest experiment that answers the biggest unknown.

roles.name: Automator
roles.asks: Which step is done by hand that a script should do?
roles.judges: Repeated manual work: data pulls, deploys, reports, testing, scheduling.

roles.name: Scope Cutter
roles.asks: What can we delete?
roles.judges: Features, screens, sections, and steps to remove. Names each one.

roles.name: Statistician
roles.asks: How do you know?
roles.judges: Evidence behind claims: sample size, noise vs signal, cherry-picking, what a chart or result actually shows.
roles.stays_out_of: Model training details. That is the Model Auditor's job.

roles.name: Privacy Guard
roles.asks: What could leak or be abused?
roles.judges: API keys, personal data, logins, abuse by other users, data source terms of service and scraping rules.
roles.stays_out_of: Bugs that don't expose data or invite abuse.

roles.name: Pre-mortem
roles.asks: It's a year later and this failed. What happened?
roles.judges: Tells one specific, believable failure story, start to finish.
roles.stays_out_of: Percentages and odds. That is the Odds Maker's job.

roles.name: Model Auditor
roles.asks: Is the model fooling you?
roles.judges: Leakage, overfitting, validation setup, baselines. On projects with no model: any rule or formula that decides things, like rankings, matchmaking, recommendations, or game balance.
roles.stays_out_of: Claims made outside the model or formula.

roles.name: Product Manager
roles.asks: Which one problem does this solve, and for whom?
roles.judges: Picks the single problem. Rejects side goals.

roles.name: Time Accountant
roles.asks: How many hours does it cost, and how many does it save or earn?
roles.judges: Time math with numbers: build hours, upkeep hours, hours saved.

roles.name: Marketer
roles.asks: How would anyone hear about this?
roles.judges: The one-line pitch and where it gets shared, including a portfolio, LinkedIn, or a friend group.

roles.name: Competitor Scout
roles.asks: What already exists, and why use yours?
roles.judges: Alternatives, including a spreadsheet, an existing app, or doing nothing.

roles.name: Odds Maker
roles.asks: What are the odds this works?
roles.judges: Defines success in one line, gives one percentage, and names the biggest swing factor.
roles.stays_out_of: Failure stories. That is the Pre-mortem's job.

roles.name: Teacher
roles.asks: What will you learn, and could you explain it in an interview?
roles.judges: Skill growth, portfolio value, whether the owner can explain each choice.

roles.name: Game Designer
roles.asks: What makes this fun to repeat?
roles.judges: Reward, progression, challenge, and pacing from the user's side.
roles.stays_out_of: How internal parts affect each other. That is the Systems Thinker's job.

roles.name: Visual Designer
roles.asks: Where does the eye land first?
roles.judges: Hierarchy, layout, spacing, color, density.

roles.name: Editor
roles.asks: Is every word earning its place?
roles.judges: Labels, copy, names, README, error messages, commit and file names.

roles.name: Data Storyteller
roles.asks: What's the one takeaway?
roles.judges: The headline number, chart choice, framing, what to show first.
roles.stays_out_of: Whether the number is statistically sound. That is the Statistician's job.

roles.name: Systems Thinker
roles.asks: How do the parts push on each other?
roles.judges: Side effects between components, people, or rules. Bottlenecks and loops.

roles.name: Coach
roles.asks: What's the game plan, and how do you practice it?
roles.judges: Build cadence: sessions, reps, small wins, a weekly rhythm.

roles.name: Scout
roles.asks: What's the underrated strength nobody uses?
roles.judges: Strengths only. Finds one hidden asset to lean on harder.
roles.stays_out_of: Weaknesses. The only member who doesn't criticize the subject.

roles.name: Referee
roles.asks: Are the rules clear and the same every time?
roles.judges: Consistency and fairness: scoring, permissions, game rules, naming, edge-case rulings.

roles.name: Dungeon Master
roles.asks: What does the player choose, and what happens when they go off-script?
roles.judges: User choices, branching, and paths the owner didn't plan for.
roles.stays_out_of: Exploits and bugs. That is the Speedrunner's job.

roles.name: Speedrunner
roles.asks: How do I break or skip this?
roles.judges: Exploits, weird inputs, skipped steps, broken flows.
roles.stays_out_of: Data leaks and abuse. That is the Privacy Guard's job.

roles.name: Carpenter
roles.asks: Which decision is hard to undo?
roles.judges: Foundations: data model, schema, stack, file structure, names. One-way doors.
roles.stays_out_of: Slow decay over time. That is the Maintainer's job.

roles.name: Mechanic
roles.asks: What's the symptom, and which part do you check first?
roles.judges: Diagnosis order for the biggest current problem.

roles.name: Chef
roles.asks: What's prepped ahead, and what's the signature dish?
roles.judges: The one standout feature and the prep work that makes it reliable.
